# The Workstation's Planning arrangement: a team schedule over a release plan

## Context

#20884 asks for one Workstation arrangement with a board, a scheduler and a Gantt pane, in one pull request. Its scheduler and Gantt half is built and reviewed in PR #20910; the board half waits on #20875's board family, which has no pull request yet. Julia's review of #20910 (Round 1, Required Action 1) asks for a leaf of its own for the delivered half, so that #20884 stays open for the board instead of closing with its board criteria unbuilt. This is that leaf; #20884 keeps the board pane, the card arms and the three-pane frames and Look read.

## The Problem

The Workstation shows operations panes only. A team that plans work has no arrangement that shows who does what this week beside what ships when, on one calendar, in one or two windows.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Arrangements:** `Workstation.view.Workspace` declares its documents as perspectives (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`), and Group history (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs`) carries a switch, an undo and a saved layout.
- **The families:** `Neo.scheduler.Container` and `Neo.gantt.Container` (#20874's leaves), each on provider-owned stores.
- **The board's seam:** the schedule reads `workItems`, one provider-owned store whose records also carry a board's `status` and `order`, so the board pane joins #20884 by binding that same instance.
- **Design authority:** #20884's criteria 1, 4 and 5, and #20874's design read for the Look (Clio, comment 6867893190).

## The Fix

As built in PR #20910:
- a second declared arrangement, **Planning**, reached from an Operations | Planning control in the Workstation's top bar;
- a team schedule over a release plan on one calendar (`apps/workstation/view/planningCalendar.mjs`), seeded around today with no network request;
- a switch is one Group row carrying the documents and the arrangement's name, so undo, Reset to default and saved layouts keep the arrangement, and its panes come back from their windows;
- switching arrangements keeps each arrangement's popped-out panes in that arrangement, and a window a switch empties closes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The Workstation offers the Planning arrangement, with a scheduler and a Gantt pane, reachable from its own interface (e2e).
- [ ] The schedule binds the provider's `workItems` instance; a bar moved in the scheduler is one record change; a board-shaped write (`status` and `order` in one `record.set`) repaints its bar, in one window and with the schedule popped out (unit, e2e).
- [ ] A task moved in the Gantt pane cascades to its linked successor (unit, e2e).
- [ ] The arrangement, including a popped-out pane, survives a reload and a cold boot (e2e).
- [ ] After a switch, a pane popped out in the other arrangement never docks into this one's main window, and a window the switch empties closes (spec).
- [ ] The pull request carries frames of the arrangement in one window and in two, in `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light`.
- [ ] **Look, part one:** the design read's changes for the running two-pane arrangement are folded.

## Out of Scope

- The board pane and the board ↔ scheduler criteria with real cards, in one window and two (#20884).
- The three-pane frames and the Look read's part two (#20884).
